DENIA-VIRTUAL_MATTER_ENHANCEMENT.title: Virtual Matter Enhancement
DENIA-VIRTUAL_MATTER_ENHANCEMENT.descrip: When this card is played, if you are in Black Form and have enough Virtual Matter, spend that amount of Virtual Matter and trigger the enhanced effect.
DENIA-DARK_CORE_ENHANCEMENT.title: Dark Core Enhancement
DENIA-DARK_CORE_ENHANCEMENT.description: When this card is played, if you are in Black Form and have enough Dark Core, spend that amount of Dark Core and trigger the enhanced effect.
DENIA-VIRTUAL_MATTER.title: Virtual Matter
DENIA-VIRTUAL_MATTER.description: A special energy used by Denia. It can strengthen card effects.
DENIA-DARK_CORE.title: Dark Core
DENIA-DARK_CORE.description: A special energy used by Denia. It can strengthen card effects.
DENIA-PINK_FORM.title: Pink Form
DENIA-PINK_FORM.description: Denia's normal form as a student of Star Torch Academy. It excels at cycling and setup.
DENIA-BLACK_FORM.title: Black Form
DENIA-BLACK_FORM.description: Denia's hidden Resonator form. It can strengthen cards with Virtual Matter and Dark Core, and excels at both offense and defense.
DENIA-SHROUDED_STAR.title: Shrouded Star
DENIA-SHROUDED_STAR.description: Each stack increases Fusion Burst detonation damage you trigger by 10%, and Melt damage by 20%.
